user.title: Magic Climate
user.description: Wrap a climate entity to add UI-configured presets. The wrapped entity is fixed once the entry is created — to wrap a different one, delete this entry and add another.

abort.already_configured: This source entity is already wrapped by Magic Climate.

init.title: Magic Climate
init.description:
Each section below is a preset. By default only Home and Away are enabled.

Home is the initial comfort setting, the temp band you want as your default. If you enable Eco, Home will automatically switch to Eco during peak, while your climate control will preserve the Home preset. Adding additional settings allows Home to gain smarter behaviors that layer on at different times while keeping your climate control as a simple Home/Away preset.

Each new preset you add will also create a separate setting that allows you to manually select that preset. Enabling Eco also adds a Comfort setting. Selecting any preset pins that preset until you or an automation changes it. Leave a window's times blank and its preset is only ever reached manually, never triggered on its own.

This entry wraps {source}. Delete the entry and add a new one to wrap a different entity.

comfort.name: Home (Comfort)
comfort.description: Your standard Comfort setting. Home holds this band unless another preset overrides it.

data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

eco.name: Eco energy saver
eco.description: The band to hold when energy costs more.

data.auto: Home switches from Comfort to Eco at peak time

data_description.auto: Off means Eco is available for manual selection.
data_description.start: Leave both times blank to trigger Eco manually.
data_description.end: An end earlier than the start means the window runs overnight.
data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: A band to drive the room past Comfort while power is still cheap and coast through the expensive hours.

data.preload: Pre-heat or pre-cool before peak starts

data_description.preload: Requires Eco with a peak start time set.
data_description.minutes: Minutes before peak to start. Many units need longer than an hour and may not actually save any money in a leaky house.
data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: The overnight band. Sleep will supersede peak.

data_description.start: Leave both times blank to trigger Sleep manually.
data_description.end: An end earlier than the start means the window runs overnight, which is usually what you want here.
data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

away.name: Away
away.description: The band to hold when the house is empty. Away has no schedule. You'll need to set up an away trigger in Home Assistant and have it select this preset.

data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

error.auto_needs_peak_times: Set a peak start and end before having Home switch at peak time.
error.preload_needs_boost: Create the Boost preset before pre-heating or pre-cooling with it.

error.sleep_window_incomplete: Set both sleep times, or leave both blank to trigger Sleep manually.
